description: This file defines an abstract test runner class 'GoldenPathTransactionTestRunner' for running various transaction tests on grains in the Orleans framework. It contains methods to test read/write operations, multi-grain transactions, repeated transactions, and concurrent modifications, utilizing Orleans grains and a transaction coordinator.

classes.name: GoldenPathTransactionTestRunner
classes.description: Abstract class providing a framework for executing various transaction test scenarios involving multiple grains and transaction coordination within Orleans.

methods.name: SingleGrainReadTransaction
methods.description: Performs a read-only transaction test on a randomly selected grain, verifying that it initially has expected state (all zeros).

methods.name: SingleGrainWriteTransaction
methods.description: Performs a write transaction on a grain, adding a delta to its state and verifying the updated state.

methods.name: MultiGrainWriteTransaction
methods.description: Executes a transaction involving multiple grains that adds a specified value to each grain's state, then verifies all grains reflect the operation.

methods.name: MultiGrainReadWriteTransaction
methods.description: Performs a sequence of set and double operations across multiple grains, verifying the state after each operation.

methods.name: RepeatGrainReadWriteTransaction
methods.description: Repeats multi-step read/write/double transactions multiple times, verifying the cumulative result for each grain.

methods.name: MultiWriteToSingleGrainTransaction
methods.description: Performs multiple concurrent write operations to a single grain, verifying the final state.

methods.name: RWRWTest
methods.description: Executes a read-write-read-write sequence across multiple grains, verifying the expected state.

methods.name: WRWRTest
methods.description: Executes a write-read-write-read sequence across multiple grains, verifying the expected state.
